This data set contains twenty-seven (27) scans of the Northern Whaling and Trading Company Store and Warehouse, Herschel Island. All data was captured by the Capture2Presev team.  Eleven (11) scans were collected on the exterior were collected with the Z+F 5010X on the 14th July, 2018, and registered with Laser Control V.8.9 . Sixteen (16) scans of the interior were collected with the Leica BLK 360 on the 7th July, 2019, and registered with AutoDesk ReCap Mobile and Pro V.6.1. The exterior and interior scans were registered together with Autodesk ReCap Pro V.6.1.
